evidence.quote: During the plastic deformation, reserved dislocations signiﬁcantly promote the dislocation tangling and pinning, and further form high- density dislocation cells.

evidence.section: 4.2 Deformation mechanism of recovery and recrystallization alloys
evidence.quote: The uniform and dense short-rod dislocations promote to obtain effective pinning and ﬂexible interactions

For recovery Al10 alloys, the high-density dislocation cells formed by tangling between reserved dislocations and tensile dislocations contribute to achieve higher deformation resistance, thereby im- proving the strain hardening ability.
Compared with the as-cast alloy, the tensile strength and strain of the recrystallization Al10 alloy are increased by ∼8% and ∼75%, respectively.
